title: Enantioselective synthesis of spiro[indoline-3,1′-pyrazolo[1,2-b]phthalazine] derivatives via an organocatalytic three-component cascade reaction
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,17031-17035
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01633A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Luying Song, Yuhong Sun, Renbo An, Liming Wang, Ying Jin
A series of chiral spiro[indoline-3,1′-pyrazolo[1,2-b]phthalazine] derivatives with excellent enantioselectivity were obtained for the first time through an organocatalysed cascade reaction.
